content.short: RociFi is a decentralized credit economy with on-chain credit scores for under-collateralized loans.
content.description: RociFi builds a decentralized credit economy that uses on-chain data, machine learning, and loan risk analysis to power under-collateralized lending on the blockchain. The system comprises an on-chain lending protocol and an off-chain credit scoring API, enabling lenders to assess borrower creditworthiness without requiring full collateral. By quantifying credit, RociFi supports transparent, on-chain lending with improved risk evaluation and broader access to capital for qualified borrowers.
